facts.text: Serve the beans when Rorschach eats them cold from the tin.
facts.why: In the film Rorschach lets himself into Dan's kitchen, says he helped himself to some beans, and when Dan offers to heat them says they are fine like this.
facts.fix: Serve the beans when Rorschach visits Dan's basement to warn him someone is killing the old team.

facts.why: Gunga Diner is the comic's curry house; the film transcript, plot and quotes never mention it or any curry, and two searches found no film appearance. Dan's basement is where Rorschach finds him.

facts.text: Rorschach would rather pocket the sugar cubes.
facts.why: Sugar cubes belong to the comic; the film transcript has no sugar or cube lines, and a search found no film scene. The beans are on screen, so the fix uses them.
facts.fix: Rorschach would skip the lassi and stick to his beans.

vibe.verdict: Good 1985 mood and badge, but the beans cue and Veidt's thirty five minutes line don't print and the food is still comic book guesses.
